Grab the mic. Grab your best friend. Grab a front row seat because this one fills up FAST. 🎤🔥 Drag King Karaoke is back at Azucar, hosted by Beah Hazard, and the kings are taking over the Lounge for a night that's part concert, part comedy show, part group therapy at the top of your lungs. You sing, they sing back. You forget the words, they hype you through it anyway. Free entry, zero excuses. Wednesday night just became the best night of your week. 👑🎶

No perfect voice required. No script to follow. Just you, the mic, and a room full of people who came exactly as they are. 💛🎤 Drag King Karaoke is an event put on by queens, for everyone — Beah Hazard's hosting, the kings are singing right alongside you, and the whole Lounge becomes one big Latinx family belting out choruses together. Shy? Doesn't matter. First time? Even better. This is Pasco's living room karaoke night, and everybody's invited to grab that mic. 👑🖤

Mark the calendar: Wednesday, September 16th, Drag King Karaoke takes over the Lounge at Azucar. Doors at 7PM, Beah Hazard hosting, and the kings are ready to sing right alongside you all night long. Free entry — no tickets, no cover, just show up and sing your heart out. This is every other Wednesday now, so if you miss this one, don't worry, but honestly... why would you? 🎤🔥
